messages:
matt: FYI noticed a ~2.9x transient per-token cost spike on route r-512 during yesterday's variant flip. tokens/sec steady. looked noisy in the alert but seemed short lived.
anya: saw that too. heatmap showed a sharp cache_hit collapse right at canary. PMs flagged it as a regression because our charts show the raw series without any warmup annotation.
samir: idea: add a "warmup annotator" layer to the cost dashboard that can tag windows where a model_variant rollout overlaps the metric and show a smoothed delta line. The annotator would use rollout metadata + a small smoothing kernel to avoid flashing pages.
claire: i like the annotator. UX: the card could show three small things: projected warmup penalty (minutes + $), a little sparkline of raw vs smoothed, and a link to a quick explainer: "how amortized cache savings are computed". keep the explainer short and link to RFC.
matt: telemetry blocker: we still have a lot of sampled token events without route_id or model_variant which makes the annotator blind for partial rollouts. propose we add these fields to the token sample and also a tiny "billing_bucket" tag so we can show SKU exposure in the same card. example line (proto):
```
token_sample,event=token route_id=r-512 model_variant=ithaca-16k-canary billing_bucket=sku-a100-hot cache_hit=false tokens=18 sample_weight=8 is_canary=true
```
anya: sampling policy: during any active canary, auto-increase effective sample_weight for events tagged is_canary=true by x5 for first 45m, then ramp back. That should cut variance without massive ingest cost. alternatively we can upweight only cache_miss events since they're more informative for warmup.
samir: on the forecasting side i'd like a tiny internal endpoint `/internal/warmup_forecast` that returns `{proj_unit_cost, warmup_minutes, sku_breakdown}` for a given route+variant+canary_pct. The annotator hits this every 30s while rollout active to refresh the overlay.
claire: UX note: add a small "safety tokens" field in rollout modal — engineers can set a token burn budget for the canary (e.g., 500k tokens). if projected burn > safety_tokens, UI flashes and offers to reduce canary pct or auto-pause. default is empty.
matt: also propose adding a "delta-smoothing" toggle in the dashboard settings: aggressive smoothing for on-call view, conservative for analytical view. helps avoid false positives on short warmups.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: Canary started route=r-512 -> ithaca-16k-canary (pct=7%)
anya: action items: 1) telemetry: add route_id, model_variant, billing_bucket, is_canary, sample_weight guidance (matt/ingest). 2) infra: warmup_forecast endpoint + light aggregator (samir). 3) console: warmup annotator UI + rollout modal safety_tokens and pause option (claire/ux). I'll open RFC and tag infra/telemetry/ux.
matt: thanks — i'll include a short math blurb in RFC about amortization (showing how cached token savings are spread over a warmup window) so PMs understand spikes are usually transient.
